description: The Battle Master uses martial maneuvers learned from war masters across the realm.

features.name: Battle Maneuvers
features.description: Learn 3 maneuvers. Use Superiority Dice (d8) to fuel them. Gain 4 Superiority Dice, regaining on short rest.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: Spend 1 minute observing creature to gain insight into its capabilities.

features.name: Maneuver Mastery
features.description: Spend 1 Superiority Die when a creature hits you to reduce damage.

features.name: Improved Maneuvers
features.description: Learn additional maneuvers. Superiority Die size increases to d10.
